name: io.github.tylergibbs1/backwork-mcp
title: Backwork
description: Medicare coverage policies, prior authorization, claim risk, and medical codes from Backwork.

environmentVariables.name: BACKWORK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Backwork API key (bwk_live_...). The hosted remote uses OAuth instead and needs no key.

environmentVariables.name: BACKWORK_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the Backwork API base URL. Defaults to https://backworkhealth.com/api/v1.
